events.title: Ba Trieu Uprising
events.description: In the mountainous region of Nua (Trieu Son) and Phu Dien (Hau Loc), Ba Trieu (Trieu Thi Trinh) and her older brother Trieu Quoc Dat raised the banner of uprising against the domination of the Eastern Wu dynasty, shaking Giao Chau with her famous quote about heroic spirit.

events.title: Moving the Capital to Tay Do (Citadel of the Ho Dynasty)
events.description: Ho Quy Ly forced King Tran Thuan Tong to move the capital from Thang Long to Thanh Hoa, building a solid stone citadel (Tay Do Citadel) in Vinh Loc District. This is the only unique stone architectural work remaining in Southeast Asia.

events.title: Lung Nhai Oath
events.description: In the Lung Nhai forest, Le Loi and 18 heroes (including Nguyen Trai and Le Lai) held a ceremony to make offerings to Heaven and Earth, became sworn brothers, and swore to live and die together to drive out the Minh invaders and save the country.

events.title: Outbreak of the Lam Son Uprising
events.description: Le Loi proclaimed himself Binh Dinh Vuong (Pacification King), officially raising the banner of uprising in the land of Lam Son against the invading Minh army. The uprising lasted for 10 years and ended in victory, ushering in the Later Le Dynasty.

events.title: Ba Dinh Uprising
events.description: Under the leadership of Dinh Cong Trang and Pham Banh, the insurgent army turned the three villages of Mau Thinh, Thượng Tho, and My Khe into a solid, waterlogged defensive stronghold (Ba Dinh war zone), fiercely resisting the French army during the Can Vuong movement.

events.title: Establishment of the first Party Cell
events.description: At the home of Comrade Le Van Sy (Ham Ha village), the founding conference of the first Communist Party of Vietnam cell in Thanh Hoa Province was held with 3 party members, with Comrade Le Thế Long serving as Secretary.

events.title: Seizing power in Thanh Hoa
events.description: Joining the spirit of Hanoi, the masses and self-defense forces of Thanh Hoa surrounded the Governor's Palace, forcing Governor Nguyen Trac to surrender. The Provisional Revolutionary People's Committee of Thanh Hoa Province made its public debut.

events.title: Uncle Ho's first visit to Thanh Hoa
events.description: President Ho Chi Minh visited Thanh Hoa and gave a historic speech at Rung Thong. He assigned the task: 'Thanh Hoa Province must become a model province'.

events.title: Ham Rong - Nam Ngan Victory
events.description: On April 3 and 4, the US Air Force focused on bombing Ham Rong Bridge to cut off the vital transportation artery. The soldiers and people of Thanh Hoa fought resiliently, shooting down 47 US aircraft and keeping the bridge safe.

events.title: Hoang Truong Elder Militia Platoon shoots down aircraft
events.description: The Elder Militia Platoon of Hoang Truong Commune (consisting of 18 elderly people) used infantry rifles to shoot down a modern US jet. This was the first elder militia unit in the North to achieve this feat, receiving a letter of commendation from Uncle Ho.
